mutants.description: The soft-start count subtracts the leaving bit at the run-window depth (bit WINDOW_RUN-1) instead of the oldest bit of the 32-cycle soft-start window, so fault_count_ss covers only the last 16 cycles.
mutants.reason: When more than 16 faulted samples fall in the last 32 soft-start cycles, fault_count_ss_out stops at 16 instead of the real count. With trip_ss above 16, window_trip_SS then never asserts during S_SS, and with lower thresholds it asserts late or drops early.

mutants.description: The soft-start telemetry output reports the run count of the present state while in S_RUN, instead of the soft-start count that is held through S_RUN for telemetry.
mutants.reason: After S_SS -> S_RUN, fault_count_ss_out shows fault_count_run (0 at entry, then the run-window count) instead of the frozen soft-start count. Any soft start that saw faulted cycles shows this difference.

after: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
mutants.description: The run-count telemetry output is registered, so it follows fault_count_run one clock late instead of showing the live count.
mutants.reason: Each time a faulted run sample changes fault_count_run at pwm_rise, and each time the idle clear runs after S_RUN is left, fault_count_run_out shows the old value for one more clock. For that clock it disagrees with the count that drives window_trip.
